title: First Voyage
author: SwedenJohansson
summary: A short trip: an old camp, a treasure island its quest points to, and a wreck drifting by.
description:
Palm Cove appears ahead as soon as the world starts. Finish the camp's quest and Treasure Cove appears 600 m to the north: find the map, find the X, open the chest. Reach it and a wreck drifts in from the east.
Random islands are off, so these are the only custom islands in the world.
